changes.title: Updates: a stranded run frees itself, watchers keep the finished summary [skip ci]
changes.detail:
A browser check of build 545 said no because of the Updates page. These are the repairs. No confirmation changed, and the run record is still display only: it cannot start, order or cancel an install.

- Stranded run: if the browser that started "Update everything" closed mid-run, every other browser showed "Updating" for up to two hours with no way out. The driving browser now sends a heartbeat every 30 seconds, and the server stamps when it last heard from it. After five minutes of silence a watching browser says so plainly, shows what finished and what will not start, and offers "Clear this run" to administrators. Clearing removes only the notice; an install in progress carries on. The server frees a silent record by itself after fifteen minutes once nothing in it is still installing. If the same browser comes back it carries on. - Finished summary: after a run that restarted Core, a watching browser lost "Updates finished". The page now loads sooner after a reload, so the final report could arrive while the new Core was still starting and be refused, and it was never sent again. A refused report is now sent again until it is accepted. This cause is deduced from the code, not re
changes.detail_yue: 更新頁：卡住嘅更新會自己解除，旁觀嘅瀏覽器睇得返完成摘要。 545 版瀏覽器檢查唔過，就係因為更新頁。冇改任何確認步驟， 記錄仍然只係畀人睇，唔可以開始、排次序或者取消安裝。 卡住：撳「全部更新」嗰個瀏覽器中途熄咗，其他瀏覽器會顯示「更新緊」 成兩個鐘，冇得走。而家負責嗰個瀏覽器每三十秒報到一次；靜咗五分鐘， 旁觀嗰邊就會老實講，仲有「清除呢次執行」畀管理員撳。清除只係收起 通知，安裝緊嘅嘢照做。靜足十五分鐘而冇嘢安裝緊，伺服器會自己放。 完成摘要：Core 重新啟動之後，旁觀嗰邊唔見咗「更新完成」。最後嗰次 匯報俾新 Core 拒絕之後冇再送，而家會重送到收到為止。 藍圖頁喺手機個掣自己一行；標籤頁揀選模式個名留喺第一行。 仲未喺瀏覽器睇過。
